### E&F Currency Merge -- GENERATED FILE, DO NOT EDIT
### Rebuild with tools/regen_ef_currency_merge.py after any E&F or hotfix update.
###
### Source: E&F's own common/company_types/00_ef_companies.txt -- all 97
### of its bank companies -- crossed with the tag each one is granted to in
### establish_bank_and_ef_compagnie and the currency that tag starts on in
### common/history/global/99_ef_history_global_variable.txt.
###
### INJECT: so nothing E&F wrote is overridden -- its building list, its
### prosperity modifier and its own prestige goods stay exactly as they are.
###
### building_bank: E&F keeps `#building_bank` commented out in every one of them.
### It could not have worked before -- the building was no_ownership and its group
### government funded, so no company could hold it. zz_ef_cm_bank.txt fixes that.
###
### ONE currency per company. `possible` on a prestige good is not a per-country
### trigger: vanilla only ever writes has_dlc_feature in it. Offering all 95 and
### gating them on the currency law therefore gated nothing -- the engine took one
### off the pile and every central bank on earth minted the Iraqi dinar, while the
### company panel showed whichever currency belonged to the country being played.
### A company with a single candidate has nothing to pick from.
###
### 95 of 97 companies resolve to a currency this way. The rest, and
### every country without a flavoured bank company, are served by the generated
### per-currency companies in zz_ef_cm_generic_banks.txt.
